title: Show HN: Social Network for Corporate Cringe
summary: A satirical social network platform where users can post and react to corporate jargon, humblebrags, and workplace cringe content, creating a community space for cathartic humor about corporate culture.
problem_solved: Provides an outlet for corporate employees to share and react to workplace absurdity through humor instead of suffering in silence.
why_valuable: Creates community catharsis around shared workplace frustrations while satirizing corporate culture norms that often feel inescapable.
